queries: How does a composite coating of sweet orange essential oil (100 µL/mL) plus chitosan (2%) inhibit fungal decay in tomato storage, and what factors determine the inhibition of mango anthracnose by pomelo extract combined with chitosan?

On the other hand, coatings based on a combination of chitosan and citrus extracts reinforced their fungicidal activity when tested on tomatoes and mangoes. For example, a coating based on sweet orange essential oil at a concentration of 100 mu L mL-1 with chitosan (2%) remarkably controlled the fungal decay caused by A. niger and P. citrinum in tomatoes during eight days of storage at 25circC. In another experiment carried out by Cheng et al., pomelo extract (C. grandis) at concentrations of 10 and 20 mL-1 with the incorporation of chitosan suppressed anthracnose during the storage of mango cv 'Keitt', and the storage temperature was found to be another important factor for the reduction in anthracnose in the fruit.

The control group (COP1) and coated fruits (COP2-COP4) with different treatments were subjected to the same storage conditions for 14 days, during which their visual attributes were monitored over the storage period, as illustrated in 1. The COP1 group exhibited no apparent decay until the 4th day of storage, However, after 1 week, the fruits softened, and a noticeable shift in color from green to yellow was observed. answer: 根据证据，甜橙精油（100 µL/mL）与壳聚糖（2%）复合涂层在番茄贮藏中显著控制了由黑曲霉（A. niger）和橘青霉（P. citrinum）引起的真菌腐烂，效果在25°C下贮藏八天内得到验证 [1]。这种抑制作用源于壳聚糖与柑橘提取物的协同抗真菌活性，增强了涂层的杀菌能力 [1]。对于柚提取物（C. grandis）与壳聚糖的组合，其在杧果（cv 'Keitt'）贮藏中抑制炭疽病的效果依赖于两个因素：一是柚提取物的浓度（10和20 mL-1），二是贮藏温度，后者被证明是减少果实炭疽病的重要条件 [1]。因此，温度控制与提取物浓度共同决定了该涂层对杧果炭疽病的抑制效果 [1]。
